import base64
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import stat
import subprocess

os.umask(0o022)
ROOT = Path("/home/eileenspectremoon/loa-dev/loa-aleph")
REL = Path("calibration/src-001/replay/preparation/PREP-SRC001-20260914-7ec21d2")
OUT = ROOT / REL
BASE = "8236b9f35c38cdd604b2389b42589f27755cdade"
AUTH = "7ec21d24d900ee6938b26778033210fb339da975"
EXCLUDED = {"preparation-files.json", "verification-repeatability.json"}

def sha(b):
    return "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()

def canonical(d):
    return (json.dumps(d, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False) + "\n").encode()

def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(["git", *args], cwd=ROOT)

def inventory():
    entries = []
    for p in sorted(OUT.rglob("*"), key=lambda p: str(p).encode()):
        if p.name in EXCLUDED:
            continue
        s = p.lstat()
        assert not p.is_symlink()
        if p.is_dir():
            assert stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode) == 0o755
            entries.append({"path": str(p.relative_to(OUT)), "type": "directory", "mode": "0755"})
        else:
            assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and s.st_nlink == 1
            assert stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode) == 0o644
            b = p.read_bytes()
            entries.append({"path": str(p.relative_to(OUT)), "type": "file", "mode": "0644",
                            "byte_length": str(len(b)), "sha256": sha(b)})
    return entries

index = {"format": "src001-preparation-files/v1",
    "preparation_id": "PREP-SRC001-20260914-7ec21d2",
    "entries": inventory(), "excluded_sealed_companions": sorted(EXCLUDED),
    "closure": "This inventory covers every other preparation path. The enclosing Git tree binds this inventory and the separate verification-repeatability receipt without self-hashes."}
with (OUT / "preparation-files.json").open("xb") as f:
    f.write(canonical(index))
(OUT / "preparation-files.json").chmod(0o644)

manifest_path = ROOT / "core.manifest.json"
manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text())
admin = manifest["files"]["repository_administration"]
for path in [str(p.relative_to(ROOT)) for p in OUT.rglob("*") if p.is_file()] + [str(REL / "verification-repeatability.json")]:
    if path not in admin:
        admin.append(path)
admin.sort(key=lambda s: s.encode())
manifest_path.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n")

def verify():
    assert inventory() == index["entries"]
    failures = []
    for p in OUT.rglob("*.json"):
        if p.name in EXCLUDED:
            continue
        b = p.read_bytes()
        d = json.loads(b)
        assert canonical(d) == b, str(p)
        if p.parent == OUT:
            assert "replay_id" not in d
    original = json.loads(git("show", BASE + ":core.manifest.json"))
    m = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text())
    additions = [p for p in m["files"]["repository_administration"] if p not in original["files"]["repository_administration"]]
    m["files"]["repository_administration"] = [p for p in m["files"]["repository_administration"] if p not in additions]
    assert m == original
    changed = git("diff", "--name-only", BASE).decode().splitlines()
    assert all(p == "core.manifest.json" or p.startswith(str(REL) + "/") or
               p == "calibration/src-001/core-design-basis/AUTHORIZED-blind-src-001-replay-preparation-20260914.md" for p in changed)
    assert git("show", "-s", "--format=%P", AUTH).decode().strip() == BASE
    authority_path = "calibration/src-001/core-design-basis/AUTHORIZED-blind-src-001-replay-preparation-20260914.md"
    assert (ROOT / authority_path).read_bytes() == git("show", AUTH + ":" + authority_path)
    declaration = "I authorize preparation of the adopted Blind SRC-001 Replay under the merged harness at canonical main commit 8236b9f35c38cdd604b2389b42589f27755cdade. This authority permits only the bounded replay-preparation work required by the adopted harness: independent A/B reproduction and verification of the immutable generic replay release from canonical Slice-8 commit c949ea5f39daef42d22ca2e4111164d63dffcbf1, exact frozen-input export and custody locking, preparation of the replay environment/isolation and visibility manifests, and creation of the corresponding preparation records and evidence. It does not authorize host attestation probes, provider or model calls, native worker dispatch, /loa-aleph start/resume/validate on SRC-001, creation or execution of a replay attempt, closed-reference answer access or comparison, intent-fidelity work, F-03 repair, generic Core/adapter changes, or merge."
    assert "\n```text\n" + declaration + "\n```\n" in (ROOT / authority_path).read_text()
    assert not (ROOT / "calibration/src-001/replay/attempts").exists()
    assert not (OUT / "inputs").exists()
    assert not any(p.is_file() for p in (ROOT / "grimoires/loa/aleph/runs").rglob("*"))
    inputs = json.loads((OUT / "input-prerequisites.json").read_text())
    assert inputs["exported_members"] == [] and inputs["descriptor"] is None
    for r in inputs["opaque_container_verification"]:
        b = (ROOT / r["path"]).read_bytes()
        assert str(len(b)) == r["byte_length"] and sha(b) == r["sha256"]
    release = json.loads((OUT / "release-prerequisites.json").read_text())
    assert release["build_A"] is None and release["build_B"] is None
    assert release["release_candidate"] is None
    for r in release["source_contracts"]:
        b = git("show", r["commit"] + ":" + r["path"])
        assert str(len(b)) == r["byte_length"] and sha(b) == r["sha256"]
    visibility = json.loads((OUT / "visibility-withhold-preparation.json").read_text())
    assert visibility["default_access"] == "deny" and visibility["allowed_entries"] == []
    deferred = json.loads((OUT / "attempt-records-deferred.json").read_text())
    assert len(deferred["deferred_records"]) == 32
    for r in deferred["deferred_records"]:
        if r["replay_id_pattern"]:
            assert re.fullmatch(r["replay_id_pattern"], deferred["preparation_id"]) is None
    checks = json.loads((OUT / "verification-summary.json").read_text())
    for r in checks["retained_check_artifacts"]:
        b = (ROOT / r["path"]).read_bytes()
        assert sha(b) == r["sha256"] and str(len(b)) == r["byte_length"]
    retained = json.loads((OUT / "evidence/regression-parity-retention.json").read_text())
    for row in retained["retained_raw_reports"]:
        r = row["retained"]
        b = (ROOT / r["path"]).read_bytes()
        assert sha(b) == r["sha256"] and str(len(b)) == r["byte_length"]
        if row.get("encoding") == "base64":
            envelope = json.loads(b)
            decoded = base64.b64decode(envelope["bytes_base64"], validate=True)
            assert sha(decoded) == row["decoded_sha256"] == envelope["original_sha256"]
            assert str(len(decoded)) == row["decoded_byte_length"] == envelope["original_byte_length"]
    adjustment = json.loads((OUT / "evidence/020-diff-hygiene-storage-adjustment.json").read_text())
    for row in adjustment["before_snapshots"]:
        original = base64.b64decode(row["base64"], validate=True)
        assert sha(original) == row["sha256"] and str(len(original)) == row["byte_length"]
    assert (OUT / "evidence/harness-a.json").read_bytes() == (OUT / "evidence/harness-b.json").read_bytes()
    return {"format": "src001-preparation-verification/v1",
            "preparation_id": "PREP-SRC001-20260914-7ec21d2",
            "artifact_integrity": "PASS", "preparation_status": "BLOCKED_PREPARATION_ISOLATION",
            "inventory_sha256": sha((OUT / "preparation-files.json").read_bytes()),
            "authority_first": True, "manifest_admin_only": True,
            "opaque_container_pins": "PASS", "source_contract_pins": "PASS",
            "no_export_descriptor_build_or_attempt_fabricated": True,
            "visibility_policy_only": True, "closed_schemas_preserved": True,
            "deferred_records": "32", "check_receipt_hashes": "PASS",
            "raw_log_lossless_encoding": "PASS", "prior_failure_snapshots": "PASS",
            "non_claims": ["complete preparation", "input export", "A/B reproduction", "executor isolation",
                           "negative access", "cognitive blindness", "execution", "comparison"]}

a = canonical(verify())
b = canonical(verify())
assert a == b
receipt = {"format": "src001-preparation-verification-repeatability/v1",
    "preparation_id": "PREP-SRC001-20260914-7ec21d2",
    "byte_equal": True, "normalization": "NONE",
    "canonical_report_A": a.decode(), "canonical_report_B": b.decode(),
    "byte_length_A": str(len(a)), "byte_length_B": str(len(b)),
    "sha256_A": sha(a), "sha256_B": sha(b),
    "verifier_source": Path(__file__).read_text(), "verifier_sha256": sha(Path(__file__).read_bytes()),
    "scope": "Independent re-opening of fixed preparation administration artifacts; no adopted real attempt record is instantiated."}
with (OUT / "verification-repeatability.json").open("xb") as f:
    f.write(canonical(receipt))
(OUT / "verification-repeatability.json").chmod(0o644)
print(json.dumps({"result": "PASS", "preparation": "BLOCKED_PREPARATION_ISOLATION",
                  "report_sha256": sha(a), "report_bytes": str(len(a)),
                  "inventory_sha256": sha((OUT / "preparation-files.json").read_bytes())}))
